name: thumb_lowest_stagger
expr: if(thumb_keys <= 1, stagger_1, if(thumb_keys == 2, min(stagger_1, stagger_2), if(thumb_keys == 3, min(min(stagger_1, stagger_2), stagger_3), min(min(min(stagger_1, stagger_2), stagger_3), stagger_4))))

name: bay_bottom_y
expr: if(is_one_piece, min(column_bottom_y, if(thumb_keys > 0, thumb_strip_bottom, column_bottom_y)), column_top_y - bay_length)

name: outer_stagger
expr: if(columns == 3, stagger_3, if(columns == 4, stagger_4, if(columns == 5, stagger_5, if(columns == 6, stagger_6, stagger_7))))

name: screw_mid_bottom_y
expr: if(thumb_keys >= mid_column, thumb_row_y - screw_below, mid_stagger - screw_below)

name: screw_outer_bottom_y
expr: if(thumb_keys >= columns, thumb_row_y - screw_below, outer_stagger - screw_below)

name: thumb_highest_stagger
expr: if(thumb_keys <= 1, stagger_1, if(thumb_keys == 2, max(stagger_1, stagger_2), if(thumb_keys == 3, max(max(stagger_1, stagger_2), stagger_3), max(max(max(stagger_1, stagger_2), stagger_3), stagger_4))))

name: border_minimum
expr: ceil(max(2 * (screw_hole / 2 + max(plate_thickness, bottom_thickness)), thumb_junction_spread - strip_lap + 0.5 mm) / 0.5 mm) * 0.5 mm

name: span_limit
expr: pow(48 * (plate_modulus / 1 MPa) * (flex_strip_width / 1 mm) * (plate_thickness / 1 mm)^3 / 12 * (flex_limit / 1 mm) / (key_press_force / 1 N), 1 / 3) * 1 mm

name: covered_screw_spread
expr: max(max(if(thumb_keys >= 1, stagger_1 - thumb_lowest_stagger, 0 mm), if(thumb_keys >= mid_column, mid_stagger - thumb_lowest_stagger, 0 mm)), if(thumb_keys >= columns, outer_stagger - thumb_lowest_stagger, 0 mm))

name: rows_allowed
expr: min(5, max(2, if(thumb_keys > 0, floor((span_limit - plate_border - covered_screw_spread) / key_pitch - 1), floor((span_limit - plate_border) / key_pitch))))

name: longest_span
expr: max(max(screw_inner_top_y - screw_inner_bottom_y, screw_mid_top_y - screw_mid_bottom_y), screw_outer_top_y - screw_outer_bottom_y)

name: screw_length_stock
expr: if(screw_shank_needed <= 4 mm, 4 mm, if(screw_shank_needed <= 5 mm, 5 mm, if(screw_shank_needed <= 6 mm, 6 mm, 8 mm)))

name: plate_flex
label: Plate flex at a key press

name: Solid plate down column 3 into the thumb strip

rows
label: Rows of keys
description: Rows in every column, counted up from the bottom row. Three rows is a typing layout, a fourth adds a number row. On acrylic the unsupported span limits the rows.

name: columns
label: Columns per hand
description: Columns on each hand, counted from the inner column outwards; the outermost columns go first as this shrinks.

name: stagger_layout
label: Column stagger
description: How far each finger's column is pushed forward or back. Flat is an ortholinear grid; the others follow finger length.

name: thumb_keys
label: Thumb keys per hand
description: Keys in a row under the inner columns, for the thumb.

name: construction
label: Split or one piece
description: Two separate halves with a controller each, or one plate with one controller in the middle.

name: plate_material
label: Plate material
description: Sets the colour, the density and the thickness of both plates. Acrylic cuts on a CO2 laser, aluminium on a fibre laser; anodise after cutting.

name: standoff_choice
label: Standoff length
description: Length of the M2 standoffs between the plates; longer gives more room for wiring and the controller.

name: controller_choice
label: Controller board
description: The board that must fit under the plate at the inner top corner (each half in a split board, the middle in one piece).

name: plate_border
label: Border around the keys
description: Width of plate beyond the key cells at the top and bottom edges, where the screws go.

name: laser_kerf
label: Laser kerf
description: The width your laser burns away. Measure it on a test cut; every outline already allows for it, so cut with the machine's own compensation off.

name: explode
label: Pull apart (view only)
description: Lifts the layers apart so you can see how it goes together. The cut files stay the same.

name: show_keycaps
label: Show keycaps
description: Switch the keycaps off to look at the plate and the switches.

title: Sandwich keyboard plate
description: A laser-cut column-staggered keyboard for MX-style switches: a switch plate, a bottom plate and M2 standoffs, split or in one piece, with room for a controller. Choose rows, columns, stagger, thumb keys and plate material. To cut it: File > Export..., DXF or SVG, the face sets "Cut sheet, switch plates" and "Cut sheet, bottom plates" (one file per sheet thickness), every plate once, true size, the kerf already in the outlines; export with your laser's compensation off.
